instructions: weave maps a repo: UI pages -> HTTP endpoints -> modules -> database tables, plus tests. Before editing a file, call context(files) once: page, endpoints, tables, owning change, open tasks, requirements, tests to run and the command to run them, in a few hundred tokens. Call impact(files) only when you need the complete list. Use search() instead of grepping directories; search(text: true) scans source lines when you need a literal string. changed() tells you what the graph gained or lost since a branch point. context(depth: "code") adds a short window at each anchor when you need the exact lines. Before saying a task is done, call verify(): it runs the gate on the diff, names the closest route for any broken call, and returns the commands that prove it. No tool returns whole files; text search returns matching lines only, and every output is capped. This server serves several projects: pass `project` (a name from `weave projects`) to pick one; omit it for this repo.
